content.name: Rohit Venkataraman
content.title: Head of Data Science
content.summary: Head of data science with 15 years across analytics services, general insurance, e-commerce and lending. Lead a team of 14 at a Pune NBFC, where credit scoring for thin-file borrowers expanded approvals by 18% while holding delinquency flat. Combines hands-on modelling with building teams, governance and RBI-ready model documentation.

experience.title: Head of Data Science
bullets: Built and lead a data science team of 14 across credit risk, collections and fraud, managing an annual budget of ₹6.5 crore.
Launched alternate-data credit scorecards for thin-file borrowers, expanding approvals by 18% with 30+ day delinquency unchanged.
Cut collections cost per account by 22% through a contact-strategy model that prioritises calls by likelihood to pay.
Set up model validation, monitoring and documentation standards reviewed by the board risk committee every quarter.

experience.title: Senior Data Scientist
bullets: Led a team of four on search ranking for a catalogue of 2 million products, increasing search-to-cart conversion by 9%.
Developed a return-risk model for cash-on-delivery orders, saving about ₹4 crore a year in reverse logistics.
Partnered with engineering to move models from batch scoring to a real-time API serving 3,000 requests per second.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Built motor claims fraud scores that raised investigation hit rates from 12% to 27%.
Priced a new two-wheeler add-on cover using GLMs, which reached 1.4 lakh policies in its first year.
Trained 25 underwriters to read model outputs and challenge them sensibly.

experience.title: Analyst
bullets: Delivered marketing mix and response models in SAS for retail and FMCG clients in India and the Middle East.
Automated client reporting templates, shortening delivery from 5 days to 2 per engagement.
Promoted to team lead for a group of three analysts in the final year.

education.degree: M.Tech, Industrial Engineering and Operations Research

achievements.title: Industry panel speaker
achievements.detail: Panellist on responsible AI in lending at a Mumbai fintech conference (2024).

achievements.title: Team growth
achievements.detail: Grew the data science function from 3 to 14 people and promoted four team members to lead roles.
